content.text: This feeling is familiar; everyone, take a look at this night scene picture.
@老孟 Yeah, this cyberpunk-style night scene reminds me of a certain movie.
Look at this, it's an empty shot from the movie. I think this is the filming location.
@Pineapple You're right, the scenes in the movie are very similar to the night view we saw.
I found a real photo of Hongyadong. Let's see how it compares to the scenes in the movie.
@老孟 Indeed, the architectural structure is almost identical; this is the filming location.
So it was all green screen here. The difference between the filming set and the final product is huge.
@老孟 Yeah, the CGI effects are really powerful; you can't tell at all that it was done with a green screen.
Additionally, here is a screenshot of the slum from the movie. See how similar it is to the actual scene.
@Yuzu The composition is almost identical, truly a divine restoration.
This is where the main character eats noodles, and I took a photo of the entrance.
@老孟 This shop looks exactly the same as it did in the movie. It seems they really came here to film.
I ordered the same noodles to recreate the protagonist's experience.
There are also photos with celebrities on the wall—it's truly a trendy spot.
@Yuzu That's an interesting discovery indeed. It seems this place has become a tourist attraction.

@老孟 The composition is indeed very similar, especially the arrangement of those buildings.
@老孟 This similarity makes me wonder how they found such a fitting location for the shoot.
It might have been specifically chosen by the film crew, as Chongqing's terrain is quite unique and fits the cyberpunk aesthetic.
Look at this photo from the shooting location; it was all green screens back then.
@老孟, having a green screen opens up more possibilities for post-production. Have you seen the final cut yet?
@老孟 The difference between the green screen on set and the final film is really huge; CGI is amazing.
This is the final shot after the movie's special effects, completely indistinguishable from being shot on a green screen.
@Alex Comparing with the on-site photos, it's really hard to recognize the original appearance.
It's truly amazing how this technology makes movies more immersive.
CGI indeed makes movies look cooler than reality.
This also explains why some scenes appear so incredible.
Thanks to these technologies, the filming locations we discussed earlier can be presented so perfectly.
Yeah, nowadays visiting these places feels like stepping into a movie.
Next time I go to Chongqing, I must visit these places to experience the feeling from the movies.
The entrance of this old hotpot restaurant looks very vintage.
@老孟 There's a rustic charm at the entrance of this shop that really matches the scenes from the movie.
@老孟 It feels like there must be a lot of stories about this place.
@老孟 This reminds me of the place where the protagonist eats noodles in the movie; the atmosphere is very similar.
Look, this is the shop where the main character eats noodles in the movie.
@Pineapple The lighting and atmosphere in this screenshot are really nice, very similar to a real hotpot restaurant.
@Pineapple There's a warm feeling in the movie, and it can also be felt in reality.
@Pineapple The scenes in movies are always so appealing, and it's quite interesting to find such places in reality.
I also ordered a bowl of noodles, wanting to try the same as the main character.
@老孟 This bowl of noodles looks very appetizing, it must taste good, right?
@老孟 Does it feel like you're right there in the scene? Eating noodles as if you're in the movie.
@老孟 This bowl of noodles looks really spicy, just like the one the main character ate in the movie.
It looks like we've found a place that perfectly replicates a movie scene.
Indeed, this expedition allowed us to witness the perfect fusion of film and reality.
I didn't expect the details of the movie filming location to be so rich; this trip really feels worth it.
Look at this wall of celebrity photos, the film crew really did come here!
@老孟 Haha, this is like an official endorsement. There are so many group photos posted on the wall—it seems this place is truly a must-visit spot.
@老孟 That's actually quite interesting. I initially thought it was just a random location for filming, but I didn't expect so many celebrities to have been here.
@老孟 Looking at it this way, that bowl of noodles really does have a sense of ceremony, especially since the main character ate the same one, haha.
By the way, I just marked this location on the map. Let me show you.
@Pineapple Tsk tsk, this location looks so central at first glance, no wonder the film crew chose it for shooting.
@Pineapple No wonder it's Chongqing. Every corner exudes a cyberpunk vibe, making it easy to capture stunning photos with just a casual snap.
@Pineapple, it seems that Chongqing really has a bit of a 'futuristic city' vibe, and its geographical location and layout are quite interesting as well.
By the way, let me show you the effect I achieved using filters. It really has that blockbuster feel, doesn't it?
@老孟 Wow, this color grading really has something special, especially the lighting and tones—it's totally cinematic!
@老孟 Hahaha, sure thing, Lao Meng! It feels like you could directly submit this to the official movie page!
@老孟 This filter is quite impressive, especially the contrast in the background, which perfectly replicates the atmosphere of a movie.
Haha, it seems this trip was totally worth it—not only did I get to try the same noodles as the main character, but I also managed to capture such a cinematic shot. Totally worth it!
@老孟 Yeah, the whole process felt like walking through the city from the movie, making it incredibly immersive.
@Everyone, then this check-in trip is considered complete. Let's organize the photos later and post a collection!

meta.full_summary:
对话开始。
(第1段摘要): 本段通过对比现实照片与电影场景，确认了电影取景地，并通过绿幕与特效的对比，感叹CGI的强大。老孟还体验了电影中的场景，进一步加深了对拍摄地的印象。
(第2段摘要): 本段通过对比电影截图与拍摄现场的绿幕照片，以及最终特效画面，讨论了取景地与电影效果之间的差异，惊叹于CGI技术的强大。
(第3段摘要): 本段通过现实与电影场景的对比，探讨了重庆取景地与电影效果之间的联系，体验了电影场景的氛围。
(第4段摘要): 本段通过墙上明星合影、地图定位和滤镜调色的照片，收束了对电影取景地的讨论，展示了现实与电影场景的结合，达成了体验圆满的结束状态。
